messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Famotidine is a histamine-2 blocker that works by decreasing the amount of acid the stomach produces.
Famotidine is used to treat and prevent ulcers in the stomach and intestines.
Famotidine also treats conditions in which the stomach produces too much acid, such as Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.
Famotidine treats gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD).
Famotidine treats other conditions in which acid backs up from the stomach into the esophagus.
This acid backup causes heartburn.
The Zantac 360 brand of Famotidine does not contain ranitidine.
Ranitidine is a medicine.
Ranitidine was withdrawn from market in the United States.
Triplet: ["Zantac 360", "does not contain", "ranitidine"]

The relation 'does not contain' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject product or substance does not include the ingredient or component specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'is not': The subject entity does not belong to or is not classified as the object entity.
B. 'is not about': The subject information page does not cover the drug combination specified by the object entity.
C. 'not caused by': The subject medical condition is not associated with the cause specified by the object entity.
D. 'has no interaction with': The subject drug does not have a known pharmacological interaction with the object entity.
E. 'does not show up on': The subject drug is not typically detected by the type of test specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
